How to use this data

✓Each file is .json.gz with columns ts, o, h, l, c, ao, ah, al, ac, v
🕒Every timestamp (ts) is Unix epoch seconds in UTC, with no daylight saving. Bars are stamped at their opening time: D1 opens at 00:00 UTC and H4 on the 00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC grid
✓Compatible with pandas, Backtrader, Zipline and any backtesting engine
✓1 file = 1 calendar year of one symbol. Files marked * do not span the full year: it is the current year or the first year of history
✓M5/M15/H1/H4/D1 are pre-computed resamples of M1 (lighter)
🔒M1 files and the current year require a free account. The rest of the catalogue (D1, H4, H1, M15, M5 for closed years) downloads with no sign-up.
🎁Creating an account also gets you EV Risk Free: the EA that sizes your lot by risk % and watches your daily loss. See what it is
# Python pandas
import pandas as pd, gzip, json
data = json.loads(gzip.open("XAUUSD/2024.json.gz").read())
df = pd.DataFrame(data)
print(df.head())
